title: Cascader
description: Selects a value from a hierarchy of options, one level at a time (e.g. country / region / city).

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Click the input (or press Enter, Space or Arrow Down) to open the panel, then click an option to open the next level; choosing a leaf completes the selection. The dropdown grows with its columns.

default-value.title: Default value
default-value.description: defaultValue takes the path of values, one per level.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: Pass value and update it in onChange. Clearing calls onChange with an empty array.

hover.title: Expand on hover
hover.description: With expandTrigger="hover", sub-menus open when the pointer hovers a parent option.

search.title: Search
search.description: showSearch lets users type to filter every path; filter customizes the matching.

display-render.title: Custom display
display-render.description: displayRender formats the text shown in the input; here only the last level is displayed and allowClear is off.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: Disable individual options with option.disabled, or the whole component with disabled.

lazy-load.title: Load options lazily
lazy-load.description: Clicking an option that has no children and is not isLeaf expands it and calls loadData instead of selecting it. Set loading on the option, add its children to options when they arrive, and mark the loaded leaves with isLeaf: true so they can be selected.

custom-option.title: Custom options and levels
custom-option.description: optionRender renders each option with its level, maxLevel limits the depth (an option at the last level is selected), and dropdownStyle / optionStyle adjust the menu.

CascaderProps.label: Label of the input
CascaderProps.name: Name of the input
CascaderProps.value: Selected path of values (controlled; pair with onChange)
CascaderProps.onChange: Called when a leaf option is selected or the value is cleared
CascaderProps.displayRender: Formats the text shown in the input; by default labels are joined with " / "
CascaderProps.placeholder: Placeholder of the input; defaults to a localized "Please select"
CascaderProps.allowClear: Shows a clear button (labelled "Clear selection", localized) when a value is selected
CascaderProps.showSearch: Allows typing to search all paths
CascaderProps.filter: Custom search predicate; by default paths whose labels contain the input match
CascaderProps.loadData: Loads children lazily: clicking an option that has no children and is not isLeaf expands it and calls loadData with its path (instead of selecting it). Add the children to options yourself; set loading on the option meanwhile
CascaderProps.dropdownClassName: Additional class name of the dropdown
CascaderProps.maxLevel: Maximum number of levels shown; an option at the last level is selected

CascaderOption.value: Value of the option, unique among its siblings
CascaderOption.label: Text displayed for the option
CascaderOption.disabled: Prevents the option from being selected
CascaderOption.isLeaf: Marks the option as a leaf (no children to load) when using loadData
CascaderOption.loading: Shows a loading indicator while its children are being loaded

keyboard.title: Keyboard and accessibility
keyboard.open: Enter, Space or Arrow Down on the input opens the panel and moves focus into it; focusing the input alone does not open it.
keyboard.navigate: Arrow Up / Arrow Down, Home and End move within a column.
keyboard.expand: Arrow Right or Enter expands the next column (also after lazy loading) and Enter selects a leaf; Arrow Left goes back to the previous column.
keyboard.close: Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the input; Tab closes it.
keyboard.aria: The input has the combobox role. Its default placeholder and the "Clear selection" button label follow lib-core's locale.
